PreceptDef.label: weaving of dawn
PreceptDef.description: A seasonal gathering where the faithful recite the first pattern of Aeonar and renew their place within the Eternal Tapestry.

PreceptDef.label: vigil of names
PreceptDef.description: A remembrance rite where names of the dead are spoken aloud so memory remains bound to the living world.

PreceptDef.label: hymn of renewal
PreceptDef.description: A communal rite of drums, movement, and shared breath honoring the green strand of the Tapestry.

PreceptDef.label: anvil litany
PreceptDef.description: A rite of labor and praise where tools are blessed, oaths are spoken, and useful work is honored as prayer.
